Potions are single-use consumables that persist across floors.
{{TOC right|3}}
Most potions provide a temporary boost that can only be used in a single encounter, and thus can only be used in combat. The only potions that can be used outside of combat are: {{P2|Ambergris}}, {{P2|Entropic Brew}}, {{P2|Foul Potion}} (only when used against the {{2|Merchant}}), {{P2|Fruit Juice}}, and {{P2|Blood Potion}} (Ironclad only).

Potions are stored in Potion Slots, of which you start with 3 ({{Asc2|4|2}}). The only ways to increase the amount of slots you have is to obtain {{R2|Potion Belt}}, {{R2|Alchemical Coffer}}, or {{R2|Phial Holster}}.

Using a potion does not cost {{KW2|Energy}} and does not count as playing a card.

Some potions are exclusive to a single character. Each character has 3 unique potions, with one for each rarity.

== Potion Rarity ==
In most cases, including playing {{C2|Alchemize}}, the rarity chances for obtaining potions are:

|65%
|-

== Sources ==
Potions may be dropped as a reward after combat. The '''default chance''' of a potion dropping is '''40%''' at the start of a run.

If a potion drops, the chance '''decreases''' by '''10%'''. If a potion doesn't drop, the chance '''increases''' by '''10%.''' 
* With {{R2|White Beast Statue}}, a potion will always drop after combat. This does '''not''' decrease the drop chances which is relevant in cases where you trade the relic for another later in the run.
* {{2|Elites}} have an '''increased''' chance of obtaining a potion by '''12.5%.''' 

=== Cards ===
* Using the card {{C2|Alchemize}} creates 1 random potion.

=== Relics ===
* Obtaining the {{R2|Alchemical Coffer}} from {{KW2|Orobas}} gives you 4 extra potion slots, each filled with a random potion.
* Obtaining the {{R2|Lost Coffer}} from {{KW2|Neow}} gives you a potion as well as a card reward.
* Obtaining the {{R2|Neow's Sacrifice}} from {{KW2|Neow}} gives you {{P2|Ambergris}}.
* Obtaining the {{R2|Phial Holster}}  from {{KW2|Neow}} gives you an extra potion slot as well as 2 potions.
* Obtaining the {{R2|Delicate Frond}} from {{KW2|Nonupeipe}} fills each empty potion slot with a random potion at the beginning of combat.
* {{R2|Cauldron}} gives you 5 random potions.
* {{R2|Tiny Mailbox}} gives a random potion every time you Rest at a {{2|Rest Site}}.
* {{R2|Petrified Toad}} gives you one {{P2|Potion-Shaped Rock}} at the beginning of combat.

=== Events ===
* {{E2|Wellspring}} offers you 1 random potion.
* {{E2|Whispering Hollow}} offers you 2 random potion.
* {{E2|Drowning Beacon}} offers you {{P2|Glowwater Potion}}.
* {{E2|Potion Courier}} offers you 1 random potion or 3 {{P|Foul Potion|Foul Potions|2}}.
* {{E2|Endless Conveyor}} can offer you random potions.
* {{E2|Punch Off}} offers you 1 random potion.
* {{E2|Battleworn Dummy}} offers you 1 random potion.
* {{E2|Crystal Sphere}} can give up to 2 common potions and 1 rare potion.
* {{E2|The Legends Were True}} offers you 1 random potion.
* {{E2|War Historian, Repy}} offers you 2 random potions.

=== Other ===
* {{P2|Entropic Brew}} fills all your empty potion slots, including its slot, with random potions.
* The {{2|Merchant}} always offers 3 potions (more can be bought with {{R2|The Courier}}).

== Exceptions ==
{{C2|Alchemize}} and {{P2|Entropic Brew}} cannot create the following potions during combat to disincentivize stalling fights:
* {{P2|Fairy in a Bottle}}
* {{P2|Fruit Juice}}
* {{P2|Regen Potion}}
However, {{P2|Entropic Brew}} can create these potions when used outside of combat.

== Interactions ==
=== Synergies ===
* {{R2|Reptile Trinket}} gives 3 temporary {{BD2|Strength}} when using a potion.
* {{R2|The Courier}} makes it so the {{2|Merchant}} will never run out of potions.

=== Neutral ===
* {{R2|Belt Buckle}} gives 2 {{BD2|Dexterity}} while you have no potions.

=== Anti-Synergies ===
* Obtaining {{R2|Sozu}} from {{KW2|Darv}} prevents you from obtaining any potions. Any potions you had before picking this up will still be kept.
